belief: My body doesn’t matter to God; only my soul counts.
meta: A Christian look at the false belief that your body doesn’t matter to God and only your soul counts, with Scripture, questions, and homework for replacing it with the truth.
origins: Teaching that focused only on “saving souls.” Ideas that the body is a prison and the spirit is what really matters. Neglecting health, rest, or care because it seemed unspiritual. Shame about the body. Seeing physical needs as less important than spiritual ones.
teaches: God cares about the whole person: spirit, soul, and body. Paul prayed that believers would be kept blameless in spirit, soul, and body. Your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, and you are called to offer it to God as a living sacrifice. Jesus rose bodily from the dead, and God promises to give life to your mortal body and transform it to be like Christ’s glorious body. Your body matters to God now and forever.
self_statements: Only my soul matters to God.
Taking care of my body is unspiritual.
My body is just a shell.
It doesn’t matter how I treat my body.
God only cares about spiritual things.
errors: Separating body and soul as if only one matters.
Treating physical care as unimportant to faith.
Overlooking God’s plan to raise and transform the body.
Ignoring rest, health, or care in the name of spirituality.
questions: Why did Paul pray for spirit, soul, and body?
What does it mean that my body is a temple of the Holy Spirit?
Did Jesus rise with a body or only as a spirit?
What does God promise to do with my mortal body?
How might I honor God with my body this week?
Who taught me that the body doesn’t matter?
What physical need have I been neglecting?
truth: My body matters to God. He cares about my whole person: spirit, soul, and body. My body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, and I can offer it to God as a living sacrifice. One day God will raise and transform my body to be like Christ’s glorious body. I can care for my body as an act of worship.
hw_questions: Why did Paul pray for body as well as spirit?
What does it mean that my body is a temple?
Did Jesus rise with a body?

hw_truths: God cares about my whole person.
My body is a temple of the Holy Spirit.
I can offer my body to God as worship.
God will give life to my mortal body.

Caring for my body can honor God.
log: Each day, write one way I cared for my body as an act of worship.
name_example: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify Sarah completely, and may her entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

such as sleep, a walk, or a healthy meal, and offer it to God.

prayer: Father, thank You that You care about my whole person, body included. Help me reject the lie that only my soul counts. Teach me to honor You with my body, to care for it wisely, and to look forward to the day You will raise and transform it. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
